annotations.title: Answer three questions after a trip (Camp Map Pass)

description: Stores the user's answers after a trip planned with plan_trip (its followup token): camped there or not, whether the signal worked (worked, weak, none) and whether the road was as described (as_described, worse, better). Stored beside the forecast that was given. Needs the user's Camp Map Pass key.

token.description: The followup.token from the plan_trip answer.
